$comment: Text pool for the Current Events prayer category.
requests: For everyone sweating through this long heat wave.
Wildfire season is here again and the smoke has been bad north of town. Praying for the firefighters on the lines and the families who had to leave their homes.
The monsoon flood last week damaged several homes in our neighborhood. Pray for families cleaning up and for neighbors to keep showing up for one another.
It has been a hard week in our city with a lot of sad news. Asking God to comfort families who are grieving and to bring peace to our streets.
Lifting up our first responders, who have been running nonstop this summer. Give them rest, keep them safe, and give their families peace when they are on shift.
Families on the east side lost power for days after the storm. Many are elderly or have young kids. Pray for relief, and for our church to help wherever we can.
Praying for people who have no cool place to stay while the temperatures stay over 110. Bless the volunteers handing out water and the cooling centers that stay open late.

So many things in the news lately feel heavy, and it is easy to get anxious or numb. I want to keep my heart soft toward people who are hurting, here in the Valley and around the world. Pray that our church would be a place of calm and hope, quick to help and slow to argue, and that we would point people to the One who holds all things together.
details: Our church is collecting supplies this week for anyone who wants to help.
It is hard to watch our community go through this, but it has been beautiful to see people help each other.
Pray also for the kids, who often feel the stress of these things more than they can say.
We know God is near to the brokenhearted and present in every hard season.
answers: Thank you for praying. Things are calmer now, and our community has really pulled together.
Grateful for good news this week. Help is reaching the people who need it most.
The hard days are not over, but we have seen so many neighbors caring for one another. God is at work.
Thank you, church. Your prayers and your help made a real difference.
